# Change and Run

Unity 2022.3 2D 建造解谜游戏，模块化单体架构（`Assets/Game/Runtime/` 下多个 asmdef 分层）。

## Build

`dotnet build "Change and Run.sln" --nologo`（对应 VS Code 任务 `Build (dotnet)`）。

## Conventions

- C# 注释规范见 [.github/instructions/code-comments.instructions.md](instructions/code-comments.instructions.md)
- 目录结构与 asmdef 依赖规则见 [.github/instructions/directory-structure.instructions.md](instructions/directory-structure.instructions.md)
